verdict.rationale: Slack documents multiple natural-language AI surfaces — Slackbot answering questions/updating deals, AI summarization/briefings, and an MCP server letting AI agents search, message, and manage lists/canvases via natural-language-driven tool calls — which together support an AI-native user operating Slack conversationally. However, most of this is marketing copy rather than technical/hands-on documentation of command semantics, and there's no independent or community evidence confirming reliability of natural-language command execution. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of NL commands actually performing actions reliably, and clearer first-party docs on command scope/limits beyond marketing pages.
